g.text: PR #2398 · Explain Codex hook failures and preserve managed approval context
Failed hooks vanished and retry diagnostics could fail queued turns.
Bounded hook cards and typed approval context explain what needs attention.
BEFORE
AFTER
Notification::HookCompleted
Hooks vanish; retry notices become terminal errors.
Blocked work is unexplained; queued turns fail early.
visible_hook_failure / notice classification
Bound failed/blocked details; drop model context.
Hook and retry notices preserve the active turn.
CodexPermissionInput::Bash
Only command, cwd and parsed_cmd survive.
kind, reason and network context disappear.
Typed managed checkpoint context
Preserve kind, reason, networkApprovalContext.
The approval dialog labels the fresh decision.
build_permission_response
Remembering depends only on UI selection.
Managed kind is unavailable to guard the choice.
requires_fresh_human_decision
No remembered option for humanCommand.
Response builder drops any remembered suggestions.
Scope: requiredHumanApproval stays unadvertised. Issue #2396 must enforce fresh matched human decisions before enablement.
